output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large value, the 'totalSupply' += 'mintedAmount' operation can cause integer overflow and become very dangerous, allowing the owner to set the balance of any user to any value.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_to] += _value' operation can cause integer overflow and become very dangerous, making 'to' a nobody address to gain arbitrary token balance.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' operation can cause integer overflow and become very dangerous, allowing the attacker to burn any user's tokens.
The 'setPrices' function has a wrong logic vulnerability. When 'newSellPrice' or 'newBuyPrice' is set to 0, it will allow attackers to buy and sell tokens at any price, devaluing the token.
